qs.q: A brain CT scan demonstrates marked prominence of the ventricles and sulci, consistent with medial temporal lobe atrophy, posterior atrophy, and frontal cortical atrophy. Which of the following represents this overall finding?
qs.e: Prominence of both sulci and ventricles across multiple lobes represents generalized cerebral atrophy.
